scope: CPU simulation of oracle-grounded instantaneous reaching; no VLM, learned policy, grasping or manipulation claim

target_selection.rule: 1 + (index in the original declared split seed list modulo 2); preserve index when replaying a subset
target_selection.grounding: SimGrounder privileged simulator metadata; exact unique object name; assert matched identity

arm_definitions.grounded_executor: HierarchicalExecutor move_to policy; proportional action toward the named live target
arm_definitions.first_object_action_ablation: Replace only move_to actions with proportional control toward live object0; retain the correct named live target success and stopping rule; not a full reproduction of the old pipeline
arm_definitions.random_xyz_open: Seed action_space with episode seed; sample its four-dimensional Box every step, retain xyz and force gripper to +1
arm_definitions.zero_xyz_open: Zero xyz action with gripper +1; passive-motion negative control

success.predicate: Euclidean distance from end-effector site to current named target body center strictly less than threshold_m after a step
success.initially_satisfied: Record separately, perform zero steps and count as not genuine success
success.denominator: All selected episodes, including initially satisfied episodes
success.stop: First named-target hit, environment termination/truncation or 200-step horizon
success.limitations: Instantaneous proximity only; no stable hold, no fixed-point target, no no-contact claim. Live target movement is recorded; no settling phase.

pairing: Every arm resets a fresh environment and action RNG with the same episode seed; full initial snapshot hash and named target must match exactly

analysis.interval: Wilson score 95% endpoints, z=1.96, on genuine-success count/full denominator
analysis.interpretation: Descriptive paired difference; no inferential significance claim

trace: Full precision columnar post-step EE/current named target/object0 positions and actions; no rounding. JSON gzip is optional for compact storage.
freeze_rule: Commit this protocol and implementation before running held_out_seeds. Development smoke uses only seeds 17 and 18; no tuning on held-out outcomes.
